items.question: 上个月的销售额是多少
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) >= '2026-09'

items.question: 上月华南地区的毛利率
items.gold_sql: SELECT (SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)) - SUM(oi.quantity*p.supply_cost)) / SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.region='华南' AND strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) >= '2026-09'
